subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support Control UI public assets on legacy or unknown deep routes such as `/connections/`, or only on current known routes plus configured `gateway.controlUi.basePath` mounts?
rationale: Current main fixes the normal root/logo path and the configured-basePath path-prefix case, but the remaining issue discussion turns on which deep URLs are supported product surface versus obsolete bookmarks or unsupported routes.

options.title: Support legacy deep routes
options.body: Add or adopt a narrow fix for legacy/non-tab deep-route hard refreshes and prove public assets, chunks, favicon, and avatar fallbacks from those URLs.

options.title: Scope to current routes
options.body: Confirm that unknown legacy deep routes are unsupported, close the linked fork PR, and leave current root/configured-basePath behavior as the maintained contract.

recommendation.title: Support legacy deep routes
recommendation.body: Add or adopt a narrow fix for legacy/non-tab deep-route hard refreshes and prove public assets, chunks, favicon, and avatar fallbacks from those URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Control UI gateway serving, basePath behavior, and public asset routing, making them the best available owner for the product-boundary choice.
